comment: Class is actually treated as a 101 and intro level class so expectations and workload are very reasonable. Graded assignments were either a 1 to 2pg reflection or analysis write up every other week. Dr. Driscoll is extremely clear with his lectures and rubrics and he's understanding, a fair grader, and just an overall great person and professor!

Dr. Driscoll is a fantastic lecturer-- very clear and makes content relatable. However, he is an unreasonably tough grader. Don't expect above an A- on essays unless you give a nearly irrefutable argument. Quizzes and exams are also written somewhat unclearly; reading quizzes are sometimes hard to pass even if you fully understand the material.
